atoms.sound: The fingers on a pair of hands can be used to count to ten.

instruction.text: To count to twenty you need two pairs of hands. Select two pairs of hands.

trainers.finishSound: There are 2 pairs of hands. This means there are 20 fingers.

instruction.text: To count to thirty you need three pairs of hands. Select three pairs of hands.

trainers.finishSound: There are 3 pairs of hands. This means there are 30 fingers.

instruction.text: To count to forty you need four pairs of hands. Select four pairs of hands.
instruction.sound: To count to forty you need four-pairs of hands. Select four-pairs of hands.

trainers.finishSound: There are four-pairs of hands. This means there are 40 fingers.

instruction.text: To count to fifty you need five pairs of hands. Select five pairs of hands.

trainers.finishSound: There are 5 pairs of hands. This means there are 50 fingers.

instruction.text: To count to sixty you need six pairs of hands. Select six pairs of hands.

trainers.finishSound: There are 6 pairs of hands. This means there are 60 fingers.

instruction.text: To count to seventy you need seven pairs of hands. Select seven pairs of hands.

trainers.finishSound: There are 7 pairs of hands. This means there are 70 fingers.

instruction.text: To count to eighty you need eight pairs of hands. Select eight pairs of hands.

trainers.finishSound: There are 8 pairs of hands. This means there are 80 fingers.

instruction.text: To count to ninety you need nine pairs of hands. Select nine pairs of hands.

trainers.finishSound: There are 9 pairs of hands. This means there are 90 fingers.
